name: Find Google Maps leads with verified emails and a drafted opener using one AI agent and looot

parameters.content:
## Google Maps leads with a verified email and a first line

### How it works
1. You fill in a form: a business type, a place, how many leads and what you offer.
2. One AI agent searches Google Maps through looot, reads each business website for an email and something specific about them, and verifies the email.
3. It drafts a two sentence opener per business from what the site says.
4. Each business lands in Google Sheets with contact details, email status, notes from the site and the opener.

One looot credential replaces the Apify and Firecrawl accounts this flow usually needs.

**Cost per run**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: Google Maps search $0.001 per call, a page read from $0.0002, verify $0.00145. 20 leads cost about $0.04 in data. Each call is capped at $0.03 and the agent at 45 steps, so a run can never spend more than $1.35. Model tokens are billed by OpenAI.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- Google Sheets and OpenAI credentials.
- A sheet named Leads with the headers: name, address, phone, website, email, email_status, website_notes, opener, search, found_at, run_cost_usd. Set its ID in **Save leads**.
- Self-hosted n8n: set `N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ALLOW_TOOL_USAGE=true` so the agent can use the looot node as a tool.

### Customization
Change the opener rule in the system message. Add an Instantly or Gmail draft node after **Save leads**.

options.systemMessage:
You build local outreach lists.
1. job:maps.local.search with {"query": "<business type> in <place>"}; add "page": 2 if you need more.
2. For each business with a website: job:web.scrape.markdown on it (and the contact page if no email shows). Note one specific fact about them in website_notes.
3. If you found an email: job:people.email.verify with {"email": "..."}.
4. opener: two sentences under 40 words that use the fact and connect it to our offer.
Never invent data. Skip businesses without a website.

parameters.toolDescription:
Runs one looot data call and returns the run: status, result and actualCost. Every call is capped. Use only these ids and inputs:
- job:maps.local.search, input {"query": "dentists in Austin, Texas", "page": 1}: Google Maps businesses.
- job:web.scrape.markdown, input {"url": "https://example.com"}: one page as text.
- job:people.email.verify, input {"email": "..."}: deliverability.
